name: TAQA/ADNOC Volta Project
desc: Performed quantitative risk assessment studies for the Volta utility plants, including a Fire and Explosion Risk Assessment (FERA), Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA), Flare and Vent Radiation & Dispersion study, CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) study, and Building Fire and Safety Review (BFSR), all carried out in accordance with NFPA, IOGP, API, and ADNOC HSE standards.
